introduction: Arizona weatherization helps eligible households reduce energy use through improvements to their primary home. Apply through the county service provider listed by the Department of Housing.

who: The home must be a primary residence in Arizona and the household must meet current income qualification rules.
Homeowners may apply; renters need landlord permission. Eligible dwelling types include apartments, townhomes, duplexes, single-family homes and stationary mobile homes.
sections.get: The program addresses heating, cooling and water-heating energy costs while considering occupant health and safety. The provider determines the approved measures; it is not an unrestricted home-repair allowance.
sections.docs: Ask the provider for its income, residency and ownership or rental-permission checklist. Gather the requested records and discuss access for an assessment. Renters should resolve landlord authorization before work is arranged.
sections.apply:
1. Open the Department of Housing’s weatherization page.
  2. Use the WAP Contact Information/Service Areas by County document to identify your provider.
  3. Contact that provider for the application, verification and assessment process. Refer to the current income-qualification document linked by the department.
sections.after: Ask about selection and waiting time, then coordinate the assessment and approved work. Keep the completion information. Do not hire a contractor privately expecting this program to reimburse the bill.
sections.sources:
• Arizona weatherization eligibility and county providers
  • USA Assistance background and screenshots

faqs: Yes, with landlord permission and the other program requirements.
The department includes stationary mobile homes used as an Arizona primary residence.
Where do I get the application?
Contact the provider for your county using the department’s service-area document.
Is this help with a past-due electric bill?
Weatherization improves home efficiency. For bill-payment help, look separately at LIHEAP or the utility’s assistance options.

provenance.review_scope: Program purpose, eligibility pathway and application methods; no unverified dollar limits published.
